title: Wish You Were Here — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “Wish You Were Here”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Guitar introduction: Em7 | G | A7sus4 | G (repeat 3×)
Instrumental: Em7 | G | A7sus4 | G (repeat 2×)
Verse 1: C | D | Am | G | D | C | Am | G (repeat 2×)
Instrumental return: Em7 | G | A7sus4 | G (repeat 2×)
Verse 2: C | D | Am | G | D | C | Am | G (repeat 2×)
Instrumental outro: Em7 | G | A7sus4 | G (repeat 3×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Sparse Em7–G–A7sus4 guitar intro, separated lead/accompaniment attacks, stronger C–D–Am verse.
Score section map: Guitar introduction (1–12) · Instrumental (13–20) · Verse 1 (21–36) · Instrumental return (37–44) · Verse 2 (45–60) · Instrumental outro (61–72).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://openguitarchords.com/songs/wish-you-were-here-chords
